data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, a complex arcane sigil manifests on your skin. The location of this sigil varies by individual, but always appears in a place easily displayed. (Most commonly, the sigil resembles a third eye.) While the sigil remains uncovered, you gain a +%1 deflection bonus to AC. You lose the deflection bonus if the sigil becomes obscured, but it returns once the sigil is made visible once again.|1+min(5,TL/4)
